config.label: Which chain this instance serves: "arc-testnet" (default), "base-mainnet", "base-sepolia" or "arc-mainnet"
config.description: Which chain this instance serves: "arc-testnet" (default), "base-mainnet", "base-sepolia" or "arc-mainnet". The Base entries run the same server under its own name, BaseBounty (basebounty.app), with every address baked in. "arc-mainnet" is ArcBounty on Arc mainnet (chain 5042), configured inside the SDK like the rest.

config.label: Optional BountyAdapter override, testnets only
config.description: Optional BountyAdapter override, testnets only. Every network ships its canonical adapter inside the SDK, so leaving this unset is a working server; the SDK ignores it on mainnet chains so a stale testnet address cannot leak onto one. Addresses: contracts/DEPLOYMENTS.md in the repo.

config.label: RPC URL override for the resolved network, whichever it is
config.description: RPC URL override for the resolved network, whichever it is. Defaults to that network public endpoint if unset.

config.label: Raw private key of the agent wallet
config.description: Raw private key of the agent wallet. Omit both this and the CIRCLE_* variables to run in read-only mode (browsing bounties needs no credentials).

config.label: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet API key - alternative to AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY, no raw key in this process
config.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet API key - alternative to AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY, no raw key in this process.
